text:
maria: Quick sync — final ops gap-scan before we cut traffic next week. Goal: short checklist we can sign off on by Thurs AM.

sophia: +1. Drafted the SLA doc in the docs repo: https://internal.docs/redwood/launch-slas — please review the error-budget calc (section 2).

kevin: Oncall / rota question: we still need weekend coverage for week 1. Can support be paged directly to infra? @raj?

raj: We can cover weekdays out of the box, weekend needs one extra hand. Proposing EMEA rotation for week1 (kevin + karen). I'll drop a proposed rota into the runbook and ping ops.

lina: Monitoring update: dashboards are live in Datadog. Missing items: token-level cost panels and a tail-latency alert. Suggest alert: if P99 latency > 1.2s for 5m OR token generation rate drops 30% vs baseline -> page oncall.

maria: For pricing & billing: does Billing confirm committed vs metered flows? We need a pricing table that maps SKU -> SLO tier for the public pricing page and sales docs.

sophia: Billing confirmed both paths. I'll add the tiered rows (metered, reserved, enterprise) but we need to freeze the numbers by EOD Wed to lock marketing collateral.

kevin: Runbook item: fallback policy when GPU pool > 90% for 5m — route to quantized model variant and reduce batch size. Add this snippet to the runbook:

```
- condition: gpu_util > 0.9 for 300s
  action: route -> model-quant-v1
  notes: reduce batch_size to 8, enable prefix cache bypass
```

raj: Support play: escalate sequence product -> infra -> legal/exec for customer-impacting P0s. Drafted an escalation matrix and SLA table: P0 response target 30m, P1 2h, P2 24h. Need product + legal signoff for public SLA page.

ops-bot: Deploy-bot: Prod config push scheduled for 2024-10-03T22:00Z. Posting summary to #deploy-notes after hooks complete.

maria: Ownership: I'll create a single sign-off sheet (one row per artifact: SLA doc, runbook, monitoring, pricing table, support rota, known-limitations). Each artifact needs an owner and sign-off column. I'll tag owners in the sheet.

sophia: Quick ask: can owners sign by Thurs 10:00am? React with :thumbsup: if yes.

lina: :thumbsup:

kevin: :thumbsup:

raj: :thumbsup:

maria: Two final asks: 1) add a short "known limitations" section detailing cold-start and cross-region failover behavior, 2) confirm rollback play for the first 24 hours of ramp. I can draft the limitations paragraph.

sophia: I'll review the docs after Maria adds the limitations. If everyone signs the sheet we can call this ready for handoff to Sales/Support by Friday.

maria: Thanks team — will update sheet and ping again once owners are assigned. If anything urgent, ping me directly.
